description: This file defines the UserRepository class implementing the UserRepositoryInterface for handling user authentication in an OAuth2 context within SuiteCRM. It primarily provides a method to retrieve user entities based on credentials, leveraging the existing SuiteCRM AuthenticationController.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Implements user retrieval for OAuth2 authentication, integrating SuiteCRM's core authentication system.

methods.name: getUserEntityByUserCredentials
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns a UserEntity if successful, otherwise null.
